title: MPGN and C3 glomerulopathy

steps.tx: **Membranoproliferative** glomerulonephritis (MPGN) is a light microscopic histological pattern characterized by mesangial hypercellularity, endocapillary proliferation, and glomerular capillary wall remodeling showing duplication and 'tram-track' double contours. The image is histopathological features of membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis. The double contour is a new basement membrane under the endothelium.

steps.tx: The modern immunofluorescence-based classification divides MPGN into **immune-complex** mediated MPGN (significant immunoglobulin and complement staining) versus complement-mediated MPGN (C3 dominant staining with absent or trace immunoglobulins). One side is C3 Glomerulopathy, and the other side is Immune-Complex MPGN. A key point is C3 intensity >= 2 orders above immunoglobulins.

left.title: C3 Glomerulopathy
points: Absence of significant IgG, IgM, IgA

right.title: Immune-Complex MPGN
points: Equimolar or co-dominant C3 and C1q
Driven by chronic infections or autoimmune disease

steps.tx: **C3 glomerulopathy** (C3G) is defined by immunofluorescence showing C3 intensity at least two orders of magnitude greater than any immunoglobulin staining (C3 intensity >= 2+ on a 0-to-3+ scale with negative or trace Ig). The image is electron microscopy of dense deposit disease showing ribbon-like intramembranous deposits.

vis.caption: Continuous ribbon-like dense transformation of the lamina densa in dense deposit disease (StewardMD).

steps.tx: **Dense deposit disease** (DDD) is distinguished from C3 glomerulonephritis (C3GN) by electron microscopy showing highly electron-dense, continuous ribbon-like osmiophilic transformation within the lamina densa of the glomerular basement membrane. The first step is C3NeF autoantibody binds C3bBb convertase. The next step is Inhibits factor H-mediated decay.

nodes.label: Unchecked fluid-phase C3 cleavage and depletion

steps.tx: **C3 nephritic factor** (C3NeF) is an IgG autoantibody directed against the alternative complement pathway C3 convertase (C3bBb), binding to and stabilizing the convertase against decay to produce continuous, uncontrolled fluid-phase C3 consumption. The paired value for Retinal drusen is Bruch membrane of retina.

steps.tx: Immune complex-mediated MPGN in adults requires rigorous clinical exclusion of chronic viral hepatitis (**hepatitis C** with or without type II mixed cryoglobulinemia), monoclonal gammopathy (MGRS), and systemic autoimmune diseases. The first step is Adult diagnosed with immune-complex MPGN. The next step is Screen HCV RNA, cryoglobulins, and serum free light chains.

steps.tx: Acquired partial lipodystrophy (**Barraquer-Simons syndrome**) and bilateral retinal drusen are strong clinical extrarenal phenotypic associations specifically seen in patients with dense deposit disease. One side is Double Contours, and the other side is Underlying Triggers. Facial fat loss plus retinal drusen is the bedside clue to dense deposit disease.

steps.tx: **Iptacopan**, an oral small-molecule factor B inhibitor targeting the alternative complement pathway, demonstrated significant reduction in proteinuria in patients with C3 glomerulopathy in the pivotal APPEAR-C3G clinical trial. One side is Terminal Blockade (Eculizumab), and the other side is Factor B Inhibition (Iptacopan).
